draft.title: Land biomes
card: The main land biomes are tropical rainforest, temperate forest, savanna, grassland, desert and tundra. Each is found in a band that is set mostly by climate.
Tropical rainforest
hot and very wet all year, found near the equator. It has tall, dense forest.
Savanna
warm, with a wet season and a long dry season. It has open grass with scattered trees.
Tundra
very cold, with a short, cool summer. Plants are low, such as mosses and small shrubs.
draft.remember: Climate, mainly temperature and rainfall, decides which land biome grows in a place.

a.q: A region is very cold for most of the year and has only low mosses and small shrubs. Which land biome is it?
opts: Tundra
Savanna
Tropical rainforest
Temperate forest
a.why: Very cold conditions with low plants such as mosses and small shrubs match tundra. Savanna is the tempting choice for open land with few trees, but it is warm with a long dry season, not very cold.
a.clue: Think about which biome has a short, cool summer.

b.q: Two regions both have warm weather. Region X has a wet season and a long dry season, with open grass and scattered trees. Region Y has heavy rain all year and tall, dense forest. Which pair names them?
opts: X is savanna, Y is tropical rainforest
X is tropical rainforest, Y is savanna
X is tundra, Y is tropical rainforest
X is savanna, Y is tundra
b.why: A long dry season with open grass and scattered trees is savanna. Heavy rain all year with dense forest is tropical rainforest. The second option reverses the pair, which mixes up the rainfall patterns.
b.clue: Which region has a long dry season?

b.best: X is savanna, Y is tropical rainforest

problems.detail: Why (b) says 'The second option reverses the pair', but the options are shown in a random order. Here the second option is 'X is savanna, Y is tundra'. The reversed pair is 'X is tropical rainforest, Y is savanna'. The why should name that option by its content, not its position.

The remember line says climate 'decides' which land biome grows. The card says each biome's band is set 'mostly' by climate, so the remember line overstates it by dropping the qualifier. It could read 'Climate, mainly temperature and rainfall, mostly decides which land biome is found in a place.'
